newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank extends fall after downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank extends fall after downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland Plc fell on Tuesday on profit-taking after its recent strong run and in further reaction to yesterday's downgrade by analysts at Panmure Gordon, dealers said.
The stock was down 8p at 578-1/2 by 0857 GMT in volume of 578,077 shares.
"The stock has been a good performer. We have seen a downgrade and today's fall is just a continuation of yesteday's losses," said one senior market-maker.
Royal Bank shares set a record close of 595p on January 23, up some 23 percent from its level in the middle of last November.
Panmure yesterday cut the stock to "sell" from "hold", arguing that its Direct Line unit was likely to continue under pressure and that it was vulnerable to higher interest rates.
